judgments.reason: The rules state the winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin commission; that order contradicts the claim that commission is included before payment.
Commitments are sealed and only resolved (and thus revealed) when all three have committed; waiting does not reveal rival sealed bids prior to resolution.
The close action is described as settling after all three lots are sold; it does not settle the game while lots remain unauctioned.
Catalog purchases are explicitly not auction wins and the three-coin commission is awarded to auction winners after resolution; nothing indicates catalog buys receive that commission.
